payload.abstract: The Electrohysterogram records (uterine EMG records) included in the Term-Preterm ElectroHysteroGram DataBase (TPEHG DB) were obtained from 1997 to 2005 at the University Medical Centre Ljubljana, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology. The records were obtained during regular check-ups either around the 22nd week of gestation or around the 32nd week of gestation.
